scope: Persistent standard AWB preprocessing through complete PrepareMeasureResult, including numerical/luma history and complete measurement cache bytes
limitations: Execution stops at native caller instruction 0xc4ae0 after PrepareMeasureResult returns; later gain selection/reconfiguration excluded.
Incoming frame counter is explicit per frame; outer publication/counter lifecycle remains separate.
Successful allocation, strings, logging and standard memory are explicit adapters; math and native helper bodies execute.
